meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你构建或改动界面后自动跑视觉 QA:截取实际渲染画面,做像素差异对比,再派两个只读子代理分别审查设计系统/功能和视觉保真/CJK 文字,最后给出通过与不通过结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改任何界面(网页、组件、终端 TUI)后,或你提到 “visual QA”、“UI looks wrong”、“reference fidelity” 等触发词,或询问页面、组件或 TUI 看起来是否正确时触发。

say.text: 我刚改完这个页面,帮我跑一次视觉 QA。
对比这张截图和我的参考图,差异在哪里?
say.note: 会做像素差异分析并指出热点区域。

say.text: 检查这个 TUI 的边框对齐和 CJK 文字是否截断。
say.note: 会用真实终端渲染并做宽度检查。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs visual QA after any UI build/change: captures rendered screen, pixel-diffs vs reference, spawns two read-only reviewers (design-system/functionality and visual-fidelity/CJK), then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build/change (web, component, TUI), or when you say trigger words like "visual QA", "UI looks wrong", "reference fidelity", or ask whether a page/component/TUI looks right.

say_en.text: I just changed this page — run a visual QA for me.
say_en.note: Spawns two read-only reviewers, then gives a pass/fail verdict.

say_en.text: Compare this screenshot against my reference — where are the differences?
say_en.note: Runs pixel diff and flags hotspots.

say_en.text: Check the TUI border alignment and whether CJK text is clipped.
say_en.note: Renders in a real terminal and runs width checks.
